title: Move Asset Ports Into Families
description: Enforce the invariant that every port belongs to a family across compose code, schemas, assets, docs, and tests. Migrate asset-facing kit-level ports so assets resolve ports through families instead of top-level kit ports. Refactor existing implementations directly without compatibility shims, update canonical schemas and UI/data transforms, and extend existing tests to cover the new invariant end-to-end.
summary: Aligned compose family-port ownership across the canonical JS runtime, UI/react/sketchpad consumers, schema/docs, and validation assets. Family-owned ports are now flattened from `families[*].ports` for artifact/search consumers, server snapshot hydration nests ports under families, session updates route port events through families, the kit JSON schema no longer exposes root `ports`, sqlite docs/schema now require family ownership, and the validate-kit-diff asset migrates its tiny kit port into a family. Verified with `npm --workspace compose/js run build`, a focused `@compose/ui` Vitest run for `buildKitDataFromKit`, and a focused `@semio-tech/compose-js` embedded test run for `FindReplaceableTypesInDesigns` (one existing synthetic selection failure remains).
